mapper.select: SELECT rp.id AS id, rp.role_id AS roleId, r.role_name AS roleName, r.user_id AS ownerUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS ownerDisplayName, rp.channel_code AS channelCode, c.channel_name AS channelName, rp.status AS status, rp.display_title AS displayTitle, rp.display_subtitle AS displaySubtitle, rp.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, rp.intro_text AS introText, rp.sort_order AS sortOrder, rp.published_at AS publishedAt, rp.offline_at AS offlineAt, rp.reject_reason AS rejectReason, rp.ext_json AS extJson, rp.create_time AS createTime, rp.update_time AS updateTime FROM ts_role_public rp INNER JOIN ts_role_info r ON r.id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN ts_public_channel c ON c.channel_code = rp.channel_code LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE rp.id = #{id} AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status != 0) LIMIT 1
